extract_loss_functions_from_registry: iterate over nevergrad benchmark registry to extract and analyze loss functions with their domain metadata
analyze_domain_with_helpers: use ng.p.helpers.analyze to check if a domain is continuous or deterministic
check_domain_boundedness: use ng.p.helpers.Normalizer to determine if a domain is fully bounded
inspect_constraint_checkers: access domain._constraint_checkers and domain.has_constraints to inspect constraint information on a parametrization
collect_optimization_budgets: gather budget settings from experiment optimsettings for each problem in the nevergrad registry
